title: Pet Supplies Plus opens in Rowlett with plans to help local rescues
excerpt: Two longtime business partners opened their new store on Lakeview Parkway, with adoption events and pet food drives on the way.
coverAlt: Paws up, Rowlett: Pet Supplies Plus is open
body:
Rowlett's pets have a new favorite stop.

Pet Supplies Plus is now open at 8809 Lakeview Parkway. It's run by Todd McEvoy and Alan Mann, business partners who met working in restaurants. Mann spent more than 30 years in the restaurant business before deciding he wanted something more connected to the community. As he put it, they've always taken care of people, and now they're doing the same for pets.

The store carries food and supplies for dogs, cats, fish, birds, reptiles and small animals. It also offers grooming and self-serve pet wash stations, and leashed pets are welcome to come shopping.

The part we like best: the owners plan to partner with local animal shelters, rescue groups and nonprofits all year long on adoption events, fundraisers and pet food drives.

Welcome to Rowlett.
